The <code>length<\/code> parameter may either be a number value, or a binary format value that specifies the format of the length value that appears that precedes the value being read.","parameters":[{"name":"binaryFormat","type":"function","optional":false},{"name":"length","type":"any","optional":false}],"returns":"function","examples":[{"description":"Limit the number of bytes read to 2 when reading a list of bytes.","code":"let\u000d\u000a    binaryData = #binary({1, 2, 3}),\u000d\u000a    listFormat = BinaryFormat.Length(\u000d\u000a        BinaryFormat.List(BinaryFormat.Byte),\u000d\u000a        2\u000d\u000a    )\u000d\u000ain\u000d\u000a    listFormat(binaryData)","result":"{1, 2}"},{"description":"Limit the number of byte read when reading a list of bytes to the byte value preceding the list.","code":"let\u000d\u000a    binaryData = #binary({1, 2, 3}),\u000d\u000a    listFormat = BinaryFormat.Length(\u000d\u000a        BinaryFormat.List(BinaryFormat.Byte),\u000d\u000a        BinaryFormat.Byte\u000d\u000a    )\u000d\u000ain\u000d\u000a    listFormat(binaryData)","result":"{2}"}]},{"name":"BinaryFormat.Choice","category":"Binary Formats.Controlling what comes next","description":"Returns a binary format that chooses the next binary format based on a value that has already been read.","longDescription":"Returns a binary format that chooses the next binary format based on a value that has already been read.  The binary format value produced by this function works in stages:<ul>\u000d\u000a<li>The binary format specified by the <code>binaryFormat<\/code> parameter is used to read a value.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>The value is passed to the choice function specified by the <code>chooseFunction<\/code> parameter.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>The choice function inspects the value and returns a second binary format.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>The second binary format is used to read a second value.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>If the combine function is specified, then the first and second values are passed to the combine function, and the resulting value is returned.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>If the combine function is not specified, the second value is returned.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>The second value is returned.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<\/ul>The optional <code>type<\/code> parameter indicates the type of binary format that will be returned by the choice function.  Either <code>type any<\/code>, <code>type list<\/code>, or <code>type binary<\/code> may be specified.  If the <code>type<\/code> parameter is not specified, then <code>type any<\/code> is used.   If <code>type list<\/code> or <code>type binary<\/code> is used, then the system may be able to return a streaming <code>binary<\/code> or <code>list<\/code> value instead of a buffered one, which may reduce the amount of memory necessary to read the format.","parameters":[{"name":"binaryFormat","type":"function","optional":false},{"name":"chooseFunction","type":"function","optional":false},{"name":"type","type":"nullable )\u000d\u000ain\u000d\u000a    listFormat(binaryData)","result":"{3, 4}"}]},{"name":"BinaryFormat.ByteOrder","category":"Binary Formats.Controlling byte order","description":"Returns a binary format If the <code>extra<\/code> parameter is not specified, then an error will be raised if there are unexpected key values.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<\/ul>\u000d\u000aThe <code>group<\/code> parameter specifies a list of item definitions.  Each item definition is a list, containing 3-5 values, as follows:\u000d\u000a<ul>\u000d\u000a<li>Key value.  The value of the key that corresponds to the item.  This must be unique within the set of items.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>Item format.  The binary format corresponding to the value of the item.  This allows each item to have a different format. <\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>Item occurrence.  The <code>BinaryOccurrence.Type<\/code> value for how many times the item is expected to appear in the group.   Required items that are not present cause an error.  Required or optional duplicate items are handled like unexpected key values.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>Default item value (optional).  If the default item value appears in the item definition list and is not null, then it will be used instead of the default.  The default for repeating or optional items is null, and the default for repeating values is an empty list { }.<\/li>\u000d\u000a<li>Item value transform (optional).   If the item value transform function is present in the item definition list and is not null, then it will be called to transform the item value before it is returned.
